verdict.rationale: Sill is a local Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming app with no account and no server. Screen data travels only between the user's own devices, and remote access runs through the user's own VPN or a forwarded port. That local-only design is an architectural property, not a documented feature for choosing a storage region or residency, so it counts as adjacent rather than direct support for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
